title: Scarlatina
html_source: Scarlatina is an alternative name for scarlet fever which, in 1904, was much more serious than it is today. It is much more common in children and teenagers than in adults—here, Bloom is comparing his own experience as a father with that of many others. While his daughter “got off lightly with illnesses”, he acknowledges all the other ailments she was lucky to avoid.
